overview:
Priority Technology Holdings (NASDAQ: PRTH) is a payment technology company operating in the United States, founded in 2005. It provides merchant acquiring and commercial payment solutions through three segments: Small and Medium-Sized Businesses (SMB) Payments, Business-To-Business (B2B) Payments, and Enterprise Payments.

Priority Technology Holdings has competitive advantages in integrated payment solutions, diversified revenue streams, and successful acquisitions. The company offers a "one-stop shop" for merchants seeking payment processing and business management tools, with customization and flexibility options. Its focus on platforms and payables makes it a comprehensive solution for customers.

In 2024, PRTH's revenue was $879.70 million, a 16.42% increase from the previous year. For Q1 2025, Priority Technology Holdings reported a 9% increase in net revenue, a 14% increase in adjusted gross profit to $87.3 million, and an 11% improvement in adjusted EBITDA to $51.3 million.

PRTH has current debt of $2 million, and cash and cash equivalents of $59 million, with a current ratio of 1.06, indicating effectiveness in paying short-term obligations.
